OrderProcess.headline: Seven stages from inquiry to delivery.
OrderProcess.description: Quotes, samples, production dates, inspections and shipping documents are confirmed in writing so your team can track each stage.
OrderProcess.s1Desc: Share the product category, fabric requirements, estimated volume, target market and custom details.
OrderProcess.s2Desc: We itemise unit price, lead time, sample cost, pattern or tooling fees and shipping. A detailed quote is normally issued within 24 hours.
OrderProcess.s3Desc: We make the development sample, revise it against measurement and fit feedback, then prepare the pre-production sample for approval.
OrderProcess.s4Desc: After order confirmation and a 30%-50% deposit, we schedule fabric sourcing, cutting, printing or embroidery, sewing and in-line inspection.
OrderProcess.s5Desc: Finished goods are inspected, packed and cartoned to the approved standard. Pre-shipment photos are provided for confirmation.
OrderProcess.s6Desc: Once the balance is received, we dispatch the order using the agreed shipping method and prepare the required export documents.
OrderProcess.s6Del: BL or AWB, invoice, packing list and certificate of origin
OrderProcess.s7Desc: We support arrival inspection and follow up promptly on any issue using the inspection and order records.

FAQPage.headline: What sourcing teams need to know.
FAQPage.g1Q1: What is the minimum order quantity?
FAQPage.g1A1: The standard MOQ is 300 pieces per style per color for both cut-and-sew and seamless products. Samples and small launch tests can be reviewed by style.
FAQPage.g1Q2: What order volumes can you handle?
FAQPage.g1A2: Orders can start at 300 pieces per style per color. Monthly factory capacity is 600,000 pieces. The confirmed production schedule depends on the style, construction, volume and available capacity.
FAQPage.g1A3: Payment stages are confirmed in the quotation and purchase order. Letter-of-credit or account terms can be discussed for established programs based on order history and mutual agreement.
FAQPage.g2Q1: How long does a standard sample take?
FAQPage.g2A1: A standard sample takes about 7 days after the technical information and material requirements are confirmed. Special fabrics or complex construction may require more time.
FAQPage.g2Q2: Can the sample fee be credited against a bulk order?
FAQPage.g2A2: Sample fees are based on the development cost. Any credit against the first bulk order is stated in the quotation.
FAQPage.g2Q3: Can you develop a product without a tech pack?
FAQPage.g2A3: Yes. An ODM program can start from an existing base pattern, then be adjusted for the target customer, fabric and construction details. With the brief confirmed, some projects can reach bulk production in about one month.
FAQPage.g3Q1: Which fabrics do you normally work with?
FAQPage.g3A1: Common export programs use modal, cotton, bamboo or nylon. We can also match waterproof, moisture-management and antibacterial requirements. Loungewear programs primarily use mulberry silk, and custom fabric development is available at suitable volumes.
FAQPage.g3Q2: Do you produce both seamless and cut-and-sew underwear?
FAQPage.g3A2: Yes. Seamless knitting suits close-fitting, active and lightweight ranges. Cut-and-sew works well for classic silhouettes, multi-panel bodies and more detailed trims.
FAQPage.g4Q1: Can you customize labels and packaging?
FAQPage.g4A1: Yes. Options include woven or printed labels, hang tags, poly bags, printed boxes and barcode labels. Product and packaging are quoted separately after we receive the artwork.
FAQPage.g4Q2: Which trade and shipping terms are available?
FAQPage.g4A2: FOB Nansha or Shenzhen is standard. CIF or DDP can be assessed for the destination. Sea freight, air freight and international express are available.
FAQPage.g4Q3: Can you ship directly to an overseas warehouse or fulfillment center?
FAQPage.g4A3: Yes, including FNSKU labels and outer cartons prepared for Amazon FBA. Orders can also ship to a nominated third-party warehouse or fulfillment center.
FAQPage.g5Q1: Which audit records are currently available?
FAQPage.g5A1: Current records include a BSCI audit, an SLCP verified assessment and a Higg FSLM self-assessment. Other client-specific audits can be discussed for the project.
FAQPage.g5Q2: How is quality control carried out?
FAQPage.g5A2: Inspection points cover incoming materials, samples, in-line production and final pre-shipment review. Bulk goods are inspected to AQL 2.5, with results shared before shipment.
FAQPage.g5Q3: Can audit or compliance records be reviewed before an order?
FAQPage.g5A3: Yes. Qualified projects can request access to BSCI, SLCP and related compliance records during supplier onboarding.
